title: docx_generic
description: Contract of the generic advisory DOCX template (`docx-generic`), rendered by functions/delivery/renderers/docx-generic/render.py. Used by infosec-assurance-advisor and cyber-forum for deliverables no registered report template governs. House style is fixed by the renderer (Verdana, teal RGB(0,141,127), classification header) and by templates/enx-theme.json — never by the payload.

paragraphs.description: **bold** inline markup is honoured; no other markdown.

sources.description: One entry per claim source (kit path, standard clause, or allow-listed URL). Advisory deliverables are unusable without them.
